description: This file contains unit tests for the NoteUtil class, testing methods such as isEmptyLine, getLineWithoutMarkdown, generateNoteTitle, and generateNoteExcerpt. It uses JUnit and Robolectric for Android testing.

classes.name: NoteUtilTest
classes.description: Test suite for the NoteUtil class, verifying behavior of utility methods related to note processing.

methods.name: testIsEmptyLine
methods.description: Tests the NoteUtil.isEmptyLine method with various whitespace and newline combinations.

methods.name: testGetLineWithoutMarkdown
methods.description: Validates extracting lines without markdown syntax at different line indices.

methods.name: testGenerateNoteTitle
methods.description: Checks the logic for generating note titles from note content, including handling of trailing newlines and markdown.

methods.name: testGenerateNoteExcerpt
methods.description: Ensures the excerpt generation from note content behaves as expected with various content structures and markdown.

methods.name: testGenerateNoteExcerpt_sdk_30
methods.description: Special test for excerpt generation behavior on SDK 30, noting potential platform compatibility issues.
